title: The Star Cookie
can_do: 给出的选项不合适时，礼貌提出第三方案（更小、换一种）。

conversation_move.label: counter an offer with a third option

trigger: The snack options do not fit, so Child proposes his own smaller version.
setting: Afternoon snack time at the kitchen counter.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: We have cookies or yogurt for snack today.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Both is too much before dinner time.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Then what about one small cookie and some milk?

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: One small cookie sounds fair to me.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: The star cookie, please, not the round one.

turns.speaker: dad
turns.line: Good picking. Here is the star.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Small cookie, big cup of milk. Best snack ever!

replay_cards.title: Pizza night
replay_cards.setting: One last slice on the plate.
replay_cards.change: Both Child and Dad want it.
replay_cards.challenge: Child proposes splitting it into two pieces instead of taking it all, and Dad accepts happily.

replay_cards.title: The toy shelf
replay_cards.setting: Store shelf with big and small diggers.
replay_cards.change: Mom offers the small one today.
replay_cards.challenge: Child counters by suggesting the big one for his birthday, and they agree on the plan with a handshake.

parent_support: 给选项时允许孩子提第三方案，这是协商不是顶嘴。
第三方案合理就接受；不合理时说明原因，再让他改一版。
成交后让孩子复述商定结果：“一个小饼干加一杯牛奶。”
